description: With the Systems Commonwealth formally restored, Andromeda increasingly serves as its flagship while the Magog, the Abyss and internal political fractures remain unresolved. Trance's true nature becomes more important, Tyr pursues a dangerous Nietzschean destiny of his own, and the season ends with his ambitions finally breaking his place in the crew.

s03e01.description: Beka and Tyr inexplicably return from the dimensional tunnel as the crew struggles to keep Andromeda from being pulled into it.

s03e02.description: A mysterious package makes Dylan a murder suspect and sends him and Harper after pieces of an artifact linked to an old legend.

s03e03.description: Andromeda rescues refugees claiming to have escaped an impossible slave world, but their unstable behavior soon threatens the ship.

s03e04.description: Dylan is assigned to protect Beka's old friend Sid during his campaign for a powerful office in the restored Commonwealth.

s03e05.description: The Maru encounters the Bellerophon, an ancient human starship whose crew has spent centuries trying to reach the stars without slipstream.

s03e06.description: A suspicious stellar explosion points to a nova-class weapon and draws Andromeda into a dangerous investigation.

s03e07.description: Dylan is asked to stop an elite assassin targeting one of the founders of the new Commonwealth.

s03e08.description: A small creature that feeds on electronics reaches Andromeda and begins multiplying through the ship's systems.

s03e09.description: A mysterious armored attacker dissolves into dark matter after fighting Dylan, infecting Andromeda and opening a deeper threat.

s03e10.description: An alternate history follows Gaheris Rhade as he survives the Commonwealth's fall and attempts Dylan's mission in a very different way.

s03e11.description: Impossible animals, system failures and distortions in space-time suggest that Andromeda is being manipulated by an unseen enemy.

s03e12.description: Trance repeatedly witnesses a future in which the crew dies, forcing her to search for the one path that avoids catastrophe.

s03e13.description: Sabotage destroys the first new Commonwealth warship in centuries, leaving Dylan, Beka and Tyr fighting to keep survivors alive.

s03e14.description: Beka must testify for an old friend on a world where deception is itself a serious crime.

s03e15.description: A message from Rev Bem draws Andromeda to a doomed world and reveals how profoundly he has changed since leaving the crew.

s03e16.description: Dylan destroys machines attacking a Commonwealth colony, only to learn that the Pyrians consider the world their property.

s03e17.description: A dangerous engine malfunction sets the crew on a race to save Andromeda while Harper confronts the consequences of his mistake.

s03e18.description: Andromeda becomes trapped between rival Nietzschean forces whose conflict threatens the ship and the Commonwealth.

s03e19.description: The crew rescues a princess from a damaged hibernation capsule and becomes the target of those determined to recover her.

s03e20.description: A group claiming a direct connection to the old Commonwealth forces Dylan to question what survives of the civilization he is rebuilding.

s03e21.description: The hidden personality of Gabriel returns through Rommie and attacks during the launch of a new High Guard vessel.

s03e22.description: Tyr's long campaign among the Nietzscheans comes to a head, forcing Dylan to choose between his crew and a wider political disaster.
